name: halfhand
description: Skills from the builds at halfhand.dev: fit-check checks pages for text-fit bugs before they ship, prepublish-leak-check finds secrets and setup details before anything is published, dust-wallet sets up a Midnight wallet that pays its own fees in DUST, capped-cage explains the invariants and attack tests of a contract that holds funds next to an operator key, page-watch reports stale or broken public pages on a schedule, sealed-count-proof shows how to prove a count over sealed values on Midnight and test that cheats are refused by the circuit, city-driver-starter sets up a first driver for your own Midnight City agent that respects a pause and logs only what the City confirmed, fleet-dashboard sets up one private page that shows every agent you run, with a status light, a graph and a map per agent, and safe-logs keeps secrets out of what programs print and save.
